limitations: Candidates, not proof of compromise or an exhaustive secret audit. Unrecognized formats and innocuous names can be missed. Sealed or inaccessible variables may not be returned by Railway. An empty scan does not prove safety.
privacy: Values stay in memory. No telemetry. Only Railway API reads; env mode makes no network calls.
tokenGuidance: Railway invalidated all API tokens on October 22, 2026. Create a new account token at https://railway.com/account/tokens, choosing No workspace, or a workspace token for one workspace. Supply RAILWAY_API_TOKEN or use the hidden prompt. Project tokens cannot enumerate projects.
keyhouse: Keyhouse: proxy keys keep real credentials off your host, so a host breach leaks no real keys.
